title: Wedelolactone alleviates inflammation and cartilage degeneration by suppressing the NF-kappaB signaling pathway in osteoarthritis.
authors: Sun, Weichao; Yue, Jiaji; Cui, Yinxing; Feng, Jianguo; He, Qifei; Liang, Jianhui; You, Wei; Shi, Houyin; Sun, Wei; Yi, Qian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Wedelolactone通过抑制NF-kB信号通路缓解骨关节炎，仅涉及分子对接预测小分子与NF-kB复合物结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Inflammation and extracellular matrix (ECM) degradation are two major factors involved in the pathogenesis of osteoarthritis (OA). Wedelolactone, a natural compound classified as a coumestan, is isolated from the medicinal plants Eclipta alba and Wedelia calendulacea. In this study, we assessed the protective effects of Wedelolactone on chondrocytes in OA. Our findings show that pretreatment with Wedelolactone effectively inhibited the IL-1beta-induced upregulation of COX‑2, iNOS, TNF-alpha, and IL6 in chondrocytes, contributing to inflammation suppression. Moreover, pretreatment with Wedelolactone followed by IL-1beta treatment significantly increased the expression of Collagen II and SOX9, while decreasing the expression of Adamts5, MMP1, MMP3, and MMP13, thereby promoting ECM protection. Through Network pharmacology Analysis, we identified 14 key targets that link Wedelolactone and OA. GO and KEGG pathway analysis suggested that Wedelolactone primarily impacted OA by targeting inflammatory responses, particularly the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. Further studies demonstrated Wedelolactone prevented IL-1beta-induced activation of NF-kappaB signaling pathway by inhibiting the translocation of p65 and the preventing the degradation of IkappaBalpha in human chondrocytes. Molecular docking studies also indicated that Wedelolactone can directly bind to the NF-kappaB complex, thereby inhibited the nuclear localization of p65. In vivo experiments demonstrated that Wedelolactone can alleviate cartilage damage in DMM mice model. In summary, Wedelolactone appears to mitigate inflammation and cartilage degeneration by suppressing the NF-kappaB signaling pathway, thereby alleviating OA progression. Our results suggested Wedelolactone may offer therapeutic advantages for OA treatment.
abstract_zh: 炎症和细胞外基质（ECM）降解是骨关节炎（OA）发病机制中涉及的两个主要因素。Wedelolactone，一种归类为香豆素类的天然化合物，是从药用植物旱莲草（Eclipta alba）和蟛蜞菊（Wedelia calendulacea）中分离得到的。在本研究中，我们评估了Wedelolactone对OA中软骨细胞的保护作用。我们的研究结果表明，Wedelolactone预处理有效抑制了IL-1beta诱导的软骨细胞中COX‑2、iNOS、TNF-alpha和IL6的上调，从而有助于炎症抑制。此外，Wedelolactone预处理后接着进行IL-1beta处理，显著增加了Collagen II和SOX9的表达，同时降低了Adamts5、MMP1、MMP3和MMP13的表达，从而促进ECM保护。通过网络药理学分析，我们鉴定了14个连接Wedelolactone和OA的关键靶点。GO和KEGG通路分析提示，Wedelolactone主要通过靶向炎症反应，特别是NF-kappaB信号通路，来影响OA。进一步研究表明，Wedelolactone通过抑制p65的转位和阻止IkappaBalpha的降解，在人类软骨细胞中阻止了IL-1beta诱导的NF-kappaB信号通路激活。分子对接研究也表明，Wedelolactone可以直接结合NF-kappaB复合物，从而抑制p65的核定位。体内实验证明，Wedelolactone可以减轻DMM小鼠模型中的软骨损伤。总之，Wedelolactone似乎通过抑制NF-kappaB信号通路来减轻炎症和软骨退化，从而缓解OA进展。我们的结果表明，Wedelolactone可能为OA治疗提供治疗优势。
